title.narrative: Chinese JPO appointed to Education Section at UNESCO Cairo Office

description.narrative: The Chinese JPO is appointed to the Cairo Office to strengthen the Human Resource Capacity of the Cairo Office to reinforce and ensure the efficient delivery of education programme. The JPO will assist the education specialist in the implementation of the Education Sector programme in terms of Policy and technical support , capacity development, standards setting work and promoting best practices within the framework of the Adult Education, Literacy and Lifelong Learning, higher education and digital transformation, education in emergencies, Community Learning Centres (CLCs), UNESCO Associated Schools Network, TVET Digitalization, teacher education and training, Rural Education, STEM Education policies and regulations, strategies, government reports and policy analysis, education, research papers and media reports and articles, journals for the education sector programme in Egypt and Sudan. The JPO will also assist in the resource mobilization efforts of the Cairo Office.
